descriptionChirho: Qal stative sense: to be different from something else, to be diverse or distinct in character — used of beasts, kingdoms, or laws that differ from others (Daniel 7).
Qal/Hitpael intransitive-dynamic sense: to change, become altered — of a countenance changing color, of circumstances being transformed; includes qere/ketiv variants.
Hifil/Piel active-transitive sense: to change or alter something deliberately — used of changing times, laws, decrees, or the word of a king.
Hifil infinitive and Piel passive sense: for something (especially a royal decree or law) to be changed or revoked — the passive counterpart of the causative sense, emphasizing the decree as subject.
